title: Workflow
description: DVRE Workflow definition schema. A workflow defines tasks, services, and their dependencies across heterogeneous compute infrastructure.

apiVersion.description: API version of the workflow schema.

infrastructure.description: Named infrastructure targets that sections/tasks can bind to.

volumes.description: Named shared volumes declared at workflow level, referenced by sections/tasks.

sections.description: Named sections grouping tasks and services with shared config, binding, and volumes.

externalRefs.description: Named references to external data sources (blockchain assets or direct URLs).

name.description: Workflow name. Must be compatible with infrastructure naming requirements (lowercase, alphanumeric, hyphens).

source.description: 'direct': explicit type and endpoint. 'asset': resolve via dvre-asset-indexer by blockchain assetId (url → endpoint, metadata → type/capabilities).

type.description: Infrastructure type. Used when source=direct. Extensible for future platforms (docker, nomad, swarm).

endpoint.description: Operator REST API URL. Used when source=direct (e.g. 'http://dvre-k8s-workflow-operator:8080').

assetId.description: Blockchain asset ID for the infrastructure. Used when source=asset. Resolved via GET /api/assets/{assetId}.

storageClass.description: Storage class name. Interpretation depends on the target infrastructure.

executionMode.description: Within-section task/service execution mode. 'parallel' (default): tasks run concurrently unless dependsOn specifies otherwise. 'sequential': auto-generates dependsOn chain from declaration order.

dependsOn.description: Section-level dependency: no task in this section starts until all tasks in the referenced sections have completed.

binding.description: Infrastructure reference (section-level default). Overridden by task/service-level binding.

volumes.description: Volume references shared by all tasks/services in this section.

volumeMounts.description: Default volume mount paths for all tasks/services in this section. Overridden by task/service-level volumeMounts.

tasks.description: Named finite tasks in this section. Each maps to a batch execution unit on the target infrastructure.

services.description: Named long-running services in this section. Each maps to a persistent deployment on the target infrastructure.

source.description: 'direct': explicit image, command, args, env, resources. 'asset': resolve defaults via dvre-asset-indexer by blockchain assetId (asset_type=FUNCTION). Workflow-level fields override asset-provided defaults.

assetId.description: Blockchain asset ID for a FUNCTION-type asset. Used when source=asset. Resolved via GET /api/assets/{assetId}. Asset metadata provides defaults for image, command, args, env, resources.

image.description: Container image (e.g. 'python:3.11', 'myregistry/myapp:latest'). Required when source=direct. Overrides asset-provided image when source=asset.

command.description: Container entrypoint override. Overrides asset-provided command when source=asset.

args.description: Container arguments. Overrides asset-provided args when source=asset.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the container. When source=asset, merges with asset-provided env (workflow-level keys override asset keys).

externalRefs.description: Names of workflow-level external refs this task consumes. Data is fetched and placed at /externalRefs/<refName>/ before the task starts.

volumes.description: Additional volume references beyond section volumes.

volumeMounts.description: Map of volume name to container mount path.

dependsOn.description: DAG edges. Unqualified names within the same section ('taskName'), qualified names across sections ('section.taskName').

source.description: 'direct': explicit image, command, args, env, resources. 'asset': resolve defaults via dvre-asset-indexer by blockchain assetId (asset_type=FUNCTION). Workflow-level fields override asset-provided defaults.

assetId.description: Blockchain asset ID for a FUNCTION-type asset. Used when source=asset. Resolved via GET /api/assets/{assetId}. Asset metadata provides defaults for image, command, args, env, resources.

image.description: Container image. Required when source=direct. Overrides asset-provided image when source=asset.

command.description: Container entrypoint override. Overrides asset-provided command when source=asset.

args.description: Container arguments. Overrides asset-provided args when source=asset.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the container. When source=asset, merges with asset-provided env (workflow-level keys override asset keys).

externalRefs.description: Names of workflow-level external refs this service consumes.

volumes.description: Additional volume references beyond section volumes.

volumeMounts.description: Map of volume name to container mount path.

dependsOn.description: DAG edges. Unqualified names within the same section ('serviceName'), qualified names across sections ('section.serviceName').

port.description: Container port the service listens on. Always specified at workflow level (deployment concern, not intrinsic to the asset).

replicas.description: Number of service replicas. Always specified at workflow level (deployment concern, not intrinsic to the asset). Defaults to 1.

source.description: 'asset': resolve via dvre-asset-indexer by blockchain assetId. 'direct': explicit URL/protocol/credentials.

assetId.description: Blockchain asset ID. Used when source=asset. Resolved via GET /api/assets/{assetId}.

uri.description: Direct URI to the data source. Used when source=direct (e.g. 's3://bucket/path', 'https://example.com/data').

credentials.description: Credentials reference for accessing an external data source.

secretRef.description: Secret reference containing credentials (keys vary by protocol: accessKeyId/secretAccessKey for S3, etc.).
